name: Neto Malinda Trading Ltd.
summary: Neto Malinda Trading Ltd. engages in the production, import, marketing, and distribution of kosher food and household consumer products. It is involved in the import, purchase of local produce, processing, distribution, and marketing of fresh, frozen, and processed meats and fish products; production and import of canned tuna, vegetables, fruits, and grocery products, such as rice and pasta; and production, distribution, and marketing of pizzas, processed cheeses, burekas, malawach, jachnun, and pasties. The company also engages in the production, distribution, and marketing of special kosher products for the ultra-Orthodox sector under the Atara, Khilot, Basar Ha'Kfar, Delicateso, and Hidur…
